name: Spam Buffer
description: Smooths uneven click spam (alternate spam, wave spam, ship straight-fly) into steady timing.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the spam buffer on or off.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs in practice mode so normal runs stay unmodified.

fly-only.name: Ship and wave only
fly-only.description: Only buffer while you are a ship or a wave.

spam-threshold.name: Spam threshold (ms)
spam-threshold.description: Inputs closer together than this count as spam.

max-delay.name: Max delay (ms)
max-delay.description: The most an input can be held back. Lower feels more responsive, higher smooths more.
